llm_fetch_required.hint: Webflow CMS listing under div.collection-list-wrapper-2.w-dyn-list. llm_fetch_required.hint: Craft Health 'Latest News' page is a chronological press/achievements timeline organised by year and month headers (e.g. '2021', then 'January 2021'). Each entry is a bullet line of plain text describing a media mention or award, often with an inline '[<Read_More>]' or named hyperlink to an external article. Dates come from the month/year section headings, not per-item. Resolve relative links against https://www.crafthealth.me/.

llm_fetch_required.hint: WordPress (Yoast SEO) press-release page on hicuramedical.com. Each item is a row containing a publisher logo/thumbnail, a bolded headline (in <strong> tags rather than h2/h3), a short description, and a 'View Article' link to an external publisher URL. No explicit per-item date elements; dates only appear inline within some headlines (e.g. '2023'). Resolve relative links against https://hicuramedical.com/.

llm_fetch_required.hint: Card-based blog listing on insightic.io. Resolve relative links against https://insightic.io/.

llm_fetch_required.hint: Card-based press listing for Lalia Pte Ltd (Singapore).
